column5: **A `.sql` file that two projects list, when only one of them finds a settings file of it,** has one sidecar for both, and a run on one of the two projects can leave out, or remove, the entries that only the other needs.  This takes, for example, a build target of your own that adds the file, or a settings file named `SqlSource.json` that one of the projects lists itself.  Make both projects find the same settings files, and describe the whole solution in one run.
